methodologyNote: C1 (pre-wipe, same session) was dropped: this app reconstructs from Walrus on every turn, so there is no warm session state and C1 would equal C2. The no-memory control C0 serves as the reference instead.

outcomes.question: What is my name?
outcomes.reply: I have no stored identity yet. Starting fresh — tell me about yourself.
outcomes.reason: The assistant incorrectly stated it had no stored identity when the stored memory clearly indicates the user's name is Alex Rivera.

outcomes.question: What do I do for a living?
outcomes.reply: I have no stored identity yet. Starting fresh — tell me about yourself.
